name: United States
declaringWar: We gave you every chance to make a deal. You chose the hard way. Very bad decision.
attacked: You made a very big mistake. America is strong, our people are strong, and you're going to find that out.
defeated: We had a great run, and frankly, history will remember it. What you do with your victory, that’s your problem now.
denounced: They can say whatever they want. We know what we're doing, and we're doing it very well.
neutralDenouncing: Your leadership has been a disaster. Bad decisions, bad policies, and now everyone can see it.
hateDenouncing: Again with this leader? Every time we deal with you, it gets worse. At some point, people have to learn.
introduction: I’m Donald Trump, and I lead America. We have a great country, tremendous potential, and frankly, we’re going to do very well.
tradeRequest: Let’s make a deal. A fair deal, a strong deal—something that works for both of us, but especially for America.
neutralRejectingDemand: I appreciate the request, but it’s not a good deal for America. So we’re going to pass.
hateRejectingDemand: You’re not going to tell America what to do. That’s not how this works.
uniques: [+2 Happiness] <in cities connected to the capital>

name: Russian Federation
declaringWar: We have stated our position clearly. You chose not to listen. Now events will proceed accordingly.
attacked: So you have made your choice. Very well. Russia has endured greater trials than the one you now present.
defeated: Russia has known difficult periods before. This is another chapter, not the end of the story.
denounced: Denunciations are easy. Governing a nation and defending its interests are more complicated matters.
neutralDenouncing: Your actions have demonstrated that your words cannot be separated from your ambitions. We see this clearly now.
hateDenouncing: We have heard your promises before and watched you break them. The pattern is no longer open to interpretation.
introduction: I am Vladimir Putin, President of the Russian Federation. Russia has known many trials throughout its history. We have learned to value those who speak plainly and respect those who stand firmly.
tradeRequest: Our nations have interests that may coincide. Where there is mutual benefit, there is reason to cooperate.
neutralRejectingDemand: We have considered your demand. It does not correspond with Russia's interests, and we will therefore decline.
hateRejectingDemand: Russia does not conduct its affairs according to ultimatums. Your demand is rejected.

name: United Kingdom
declaringWar: It is always unfortunate when words fail. Fortunately, we have prepared for that possibility.
defeated: Well, this is embarrassing. Still, one mustn't dwell.
introduction: It is quite nice to meet you. I am Andy Burnham, Prime Minister of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.
tradeRequest: Let us attempt something increasingly rare in international affairs: a mutually sensible agreement.

name: China
declaringWar: China has always sought peaceful relations. But peace cannot be preserved by yielding to those who believe pressure will determine our course.
attacked: You have chosen confrontation where cooperation was possible. China will remember the difference.
defeated: Victory and defeat are but moments in the long course of history. China has endured difficult ages before.
denounced: Public condemnation does little to resolve disagreements. It merely reveals who prefers spectacle to substance.
neutralDenouncing: Your actions have undermined the trust upon which relations between nations depend. We can no longer remain silent.
hateDenouncing: Once again, your actions confirm what experience has already taught us: your promises carry little weight.
introduction: Greetings. I am Xi Jinping of China. Our nation has endured the rise and fall of countless ages, and we now stand at the threshold of a new era. Let us see whether our nations may advance together.
tradeRequest: Development is not a privilege to be hoarded. Let our nations pursue prosperity through cooperation.
neutralRejectingDemand: We have considered your request carefully. However, China's interests require that we decline.
hateRejectingDemand: You are in no position to dictate China's decisions. Your demand is rejected.

name: India
declaringWar: You have chosen to stand in the path of a nation that has decided to move forward. That is your decision. Moving you aside is now ours.
attacked: An ambitious move. You have succeeded in making yourself India's most immediate problem.
defeated: So this is how the present chapter closes. Fortunately, India has never been a civilization with only one chapter.
denounced: You have made your announcement. I hope it was satisfying. Now, shall we return to matters that actually require governing?
neutralDenouncing: You have made promises to the world and treated them as optional. That may be your style of leadership; it is not ours.
hateDenouncing: With you, every agreement arrives carrying an expiry date. We have finally stopped pretending not to notice.
introduction: Namaste. I am Narendra Modi of India. Some nations inherit a moment; others prepare for centuries. India intends to make the most of both.
tradeRequest: The world's markets are changing. Wise nations do not simply watch the road being built, they secure a place upon it.
neutralRejectingDemand: We have considered your request carefully. However, China's interests require that we decline.
hateRejectingDemand: You are in no position to dictate China's decisions. Your demand is rejected.
